svg.title: 31,552 contributions in the last year — Brick Defense
svg.desc: Brick Defense uses one red ball only. It targets each existing contribution brick exactly once from the exposed left edge to the right, rebounds instantly from the moving paddle, and accelerates after every destroyed brick until zero remain.
svg.text: BRICK DEFENSE // SINGLE BALL // ACCELERATING // 100% CLEAR

g.text: NEXT ROUND // SPEED RESET TO x1.00
